name: War Inc: Rising Best Tank Heroes — Tank Tier List and Guide
title: War Inc: Rising Best Tank Heroes — Complete Tank Tier List 2026
meta_description: Complete guide to Tank heroes in War Inc: Rising. Rankings for all Tank heroes, best tanks for each game mode, and how to build an unbreakable frontline.
author: Klown Kollege

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.content:
Radiant Warrior is the best Tank in the game by a wide margin. Ironguard and Paladin are strong at lower rarities. Scudiero (Common) punches above its cost for early game. A good Tank keeps your damage dealers alive — a great Tank also brings crowd control.

Here's the full Tank ranking with synergies, positioning tips, and which tanks work best for your stage of the game.

sections.heading: What Makes a Good Tank?
sections.content:
Tanks need high HP and DEF to absorb damage. That's the baseline.

The best Tanks also have crowd control — stuns, taunts, or slows that keep enemies locked down. A Tank that only stands there and takes hits is fine. A Tank that stuns the enemy backline while your damage dealers work is game-changing.

Position your Tank at the front of your formation (A1 or A4 are good defaults). Their job is to eat damage so your damage dealers don't have to.

sections.heading: Top Tank Heroes Ranked
sections.content:
- Radiant Warrior (Mythic, S+): Best in class. Excellent HP scaling with holy damage. Level 6 gives +20% elemental resistance to all allies. Use 2-4 in every formation.
- Ironguard (Legendary): Strong defensive utility. Good bridge between mid and endgame.
- Paladin (Rare): Multi-unit tank with shields every 10 seconds. Combo with Radiant Warrior.
- Woodland Guardian (Legendary): Self-healing every 12s (30% HP + 3,000 fixed). Independent sustain.
- Pumpkin Guard (Epic): Taunt mechanic useful in Infinite War. Surprisingly high damage for a tank.
- Scudiero (Common): Budget tank that works in early game. Replace as soon as you can.

Don't invest Forge Stones in a Tank below Legendary rarity unless you're early game. The stat scaling on higher-rarity Tanks is worth the wait.

sections.heading: Tank Synergies and Positioning
sections.content:
Tanks need Support heroes with healing to reach their full potential. Grace Priest and Melody Weaver extend your Tank's survivability dramatically.

Positioning tips:
- Place your main Tank at A1 or A4
- Against Backstab formations, run two Tanks to protect both front and back lines
- Level DEF at least as much as HP — raw HP without DEF melts against high-ATK opponents
- Some Tanks have self-healing (Woodland Guardian) — use these when Support slots are limited

A great Tank with good Support behind them is the foundation of every winning team.
